integrity.theoretical_basis: Brownian bridge conditional splitting; exact Gaussian posterior precision; sharp arithmetic-geometric mean optimization; singular conditional support; KL chain rule.
integrity.verification: 10704 reproducible exact-rational finite assertions are supplementary to the complete analytic proof.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns standard Brownian bridges plus an independent centered Gaussian endpoint pair with a positive-semidefinite covariance, and excludes the distinct pseudoinverse/null-space families.
The information cost is conditional on one interior cut; it is not a minimization over all globally Markov path laws.
The singular non-Markov cases have infinite conditional relative entropy, not necessarily divergent weaker distances.
The earliest motivating public source was posted on 2026-10-24; the 2026-10-27 companion paper is cited only as related-work context.
Historical-priority risk remains, especially older general Gaussian information literature.
title: Cut-information geometry of Gaussian Brownian endpoint bridges
